item.title: Globalization and the Problem of Exit
item.description: A systems view of globalization: cross-border data, corporate dependency, AI-mediated networks, planetary resource constraints, and why global coordination should not require global captivity.

item.title: Sovereignty Is Having an Exit
item.description: A practical view of digital sovereignty built around portability, rebuildability, and keeping services replaceable rather than trying to self-host everything.
